name: TrES-1
description: Star of 5,230 K, 160 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: TrES-1 b crosses TrES-1 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Stassun et al. 2017.

quotes.title: TrES-1b
quotes.card: TrES-1b is an extrasolar planet approximately 523 light-years away in the constellation of Lyra.
quotes.introduction: The planet's mass and radius indicate that it is a Jovian planet with a similar bulk composition to Jupiter.
